Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 120 minutes Total time: 125 minutes Number of Servings: 12 Ingredients 64 fluid ounces 100% apple juice (8 cups) 32 fluid ounces water (4 cups) 2 oranges 12 whole cloves 2 allspice peppercorns 6 cinnamon sticks Directions In a 4 quart stock pot, add apple juice, water, oranges (cut in half) and all the spices. Bring to a boil and simmer for 2 hours. Serve hot and enjoy! Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
